note: Both sets cover the same four facts (KP, KI, KD, and ζφ) and both contain several near-duplicate claims, so coverage is essentially equal. Set A, however, includes a damping-ratio claim whose stated condition is just 'zeta_phi', which is the property name rather than a real condition and is vague/misread. Set B keeps the damping-ratio condition tied to the text's stated rationale (compensating for neglecting negative damping from the generator-torque controller) and binds all gains consistently to the baseline blade-pitch controller, so it is slightly more faithful.
